name: Omoi Tsutaetakute
source:
Unable to say how I feel.
Afraid of ruining the friendship we have.
Nothing good has come from waiting and seeing.
Even knowing that when I find out the person I love has chosen someone else,
I'll feel a regret worse than death-----
I'm too much of a coward to say the word......

Just one word. That one word.
One word, that if I could just get out of my mouth...

I...   I... 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ192091.html/]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
无法说出自己的感受。
害怕破坏我们之间的友谊。
一直等待、观望，没有带来任何好事。
即使知道，当我发现心爱的人选择了别人时，
会感到比死亡更深的悔恨——
我也懦弱得说不出那句话……

只要一句话。那一句话。
只要能把它说出口……

我……我……

（来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ192091.html/]DLsite[/url]）
